question: Article 22 of the Indian Constitution is related to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Preventive detention.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 22** of the Indian Constitution deals with the** right to protection** against** arrest and detention** in certain cases. 
 
• It lays down the guidelines for preventive detention, which means **detaining a person without trial** for a certain period, in order to prevent him/her from committing a crime.
 
• This article also ensures that a person who is arrested has the right to be informed about the **grounds of arrest,** and the right to consult and be defended by a **legal practitioner **of his/her choice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The right to education** is covered under** Article 21A** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• **Protection of personal liberty** is covered under **Article 21** of the Indian Constitution, while Article 22 deals with protection against **arrest and detention **in certain cases.
 
• **Protection of life** is covered under **Article 21 **of the Indian Constitution, while Article 22 deals with protection against **arrest and detention **in certain cases.
